findings.title: Full pytest run exited 1 on an unrelated root-sensitive test
findings.evidence: 04-verification+gate.txt: 1 failed, 1961 passed; test/test_run_review_checks.py::test_an_unwritable_worktree_parent_is_refused DID NOT RAISE Refused (chmod 0o500 does not block root). The diff does not touch that test or tools/.
findings.consequence: The full-suite verification is not green as run; the cause appears environmental (root runner, inferred). A clean baseline could not be confirmed because the judge cannot run commands.
findings.minimal_fix: Skip that test when os.geteuid() == 0, or run the gate as a non-root user; no change to phase-wbf-08.

findings.title: Narrow verification command omits the API test file carrying R17 and R18 evidence
findings.evidence: Backlog verification lists only `uv run pytest test/test_demo_terminal.py` (56 tests). test/test_demo_terminal_api.py holds the R17, R18 and auth tests and ran only in the full run.
findings.consequence: The narrow command passes without exercising the API; the evidence for R17 and R18 rests on the full run, which carries F01.
findings.minimal_fix: Add test/test_demo_terminal_api.py to the phase's verification entry.

findings.title: A terminated pump with a live shell is reported alive and still accepts injects
findings.evidence: demo_terminal_api.py _stream_alive = not ended and (adapter.alive or not pump_done); demo_terminal.py pump finally sets pump_done=True on a send failure, while ended is set only when _run_session unwinds.
findings.consequence: After an abrupt peer loss, until the idle timeout (up to the one-hour inject ceiling), injects return 200 but their output is never captured, alive stays true, and long polls wait out the full wait.
findings.minimal_fix: Define alive as `not output.ended and not output.pump_done`.

findings.title: Token directory safety checks cover only the leaf directory, not ~/.d-system
findings.evidence: _prepare_token_directory: os.mkdir tolerates an existing parent; os.lstat symlink and ownership checks are applied to `directory` only.
findings.consequence: A symlinked or foreign-owned ~/.d-system is not detected. Exploitable only by someone who can already write to the owner's home. Within the ADR-030 text.
findings.minimal_fix: Apply the same lstat checks to directory.parent.

notes: Shadow judge (gating: false), same brief as the gating reviewer plus the runner manifest; no checkout.
